verdict.line: You lose if you eat a fully-charged Q (Cryptic Gaze) with E (Thick Skin) down; you win if you force trades while his Enrage (E) is cooling or chip him in the 49.1% head-to-head window where your Q stun punishes his commitment.

brief.thesis: This matchup is a stacking race: your Q (Tongue Lash) builds An Acquired Taste stacks that stun at three, while Sion's entire trade pattern depends on spending health through E (Enrage) for attack damage. Whoever lands their payoff first wins the exchange — his Q (Cryptic Gaze) stun locks you down for a free combo, but your own Q-stun does the same to him if he's already in E. The 49.1% win rate over 112 games reflects that this is close, decided by who plays the stack/charge game better, not raw stats.

theirWindow.when: Q (Cryptic Gaze) off cooldown and charged
theirWindow.what: He will walk up and hold the cast to stun you for the full duration before following with E (Enrage) autos. Do not stand still in his 550 range when his Q icon is lit — bait it with Q (Tongue Lash) poke from 900 range instead.

yourWindow.when: His Q (Cryptic Gaze) is on cooldown (8-12s)
yourWindow.what: This is your window to all-in. Walk in and start landing Q (Tongue Lash) stacks — at three stacks your next Q stuns him outright, and since Thick Skin (E) passively banks damage taken, you can follow the stun with a full trade and pop E for the shield if he tries to burst back.

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the stack-and-trade pattern this matchup is built on — every Q (Tongue Lash) poke into an auto triggers Grasp, which pads your health lead against his Enrage spend.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite runs a 48.7% win rate and is picked in 50.6% of games — Flash lets you dodge his charged Q (Cryptic Gaze) per OP.GG's own tip, and Ignite closes out the all-in once you land your stack-stun.

playing.title: Poke stacks from max Q range
playing.detail: Use Q (Tongue Lash) at its full 900 range to build An Acquired Taste stacks without entering his 550-range Q (Cryptic Gaze) threat zone. Three stacks land a stun on your next hit.

playing.title: Never all-in into a charged Q
playing.detail: If his Cryptic Gaze (Q) is up and charged, hold Flash or disengage rather than trading — a landed stun chains directly into his Enrage (E) auto-trade for a huge damage swing.

playing.title: All-in the instant his Q goes down
playing.detail: The moment his Q (Cryptic Gaze) is on cooldown (8-12s depending on rank), walk up and commit; this is the window where you out-trade him safely.

playing.title: Bank damage into E (Thick Skin) before fights
playing.detail: Thick Skin passively stores a percent of damage taken while out of combat — take jungle camp or minion chip damage before a trade so you have a shield ready to pop mid-fight.

playing.title: Use Devour (R) on his all-in commitment
playing.detail: Once he's spent E (Enrage) health into an all-in and is committed, Devour removes him from the fight entirely for a few seconds, swinging the trade hard in your favor.

playing.title: Track his max-health growth from Enrage kills
playing.detail: Sion's E (Enrage) permanently increases his max health on unit kills — if he's been freely last-hitting with E up, expect him to out-scale raw stats; prioritize all-ins before he stacks too much health.

playing.title: Respect his ultimate near 90s cooldown
playing.detail: Cannibalism (R) gives him attack speed and sustain in extended fights on a 90s cooldown — time your biggest all-ins for when you've seen him use it recently and it's still down.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from real games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning — stack timing, cooldown windows, and trade patterns — is this brief's own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with his fully charged (Q) as it has a long stun time, making it impossible to gain the upper hand. Try fighing him if [Q] lands while his (E) is on cooldown. Use Flash to dodge his (Q) or use [W] before being cast airborne in order to kill him.
